title: Nosocomial Meningitis: Moving beyond Description to Prevention (editorial, Korean J Intern Med 2012)

claims.text: In nosocomial meningitis, the most common organisms by rank were coagulase-negative staphylococci, Acinetobacter species, and Staphylococcus aureus.
claims.byte_quote: the most common organisms by rank were coagulase-negative staphylococci, *Acinetobacter* species, and *Staphylococcus aureus*

claims.text: Acinetobacter species are nosocomial pathogens of increasing importance.
claims.byte_quote: _Acinetobacter_ species are nosocomial pathogens of increasing importance

claims.text: Acinetobacter was the second most common cause of nosocomial meningitis in this cohort.
claims.byte_quote: _Acinetobacter_ was the second most common cause of nosocomial meningitis

claims.text: Most of the nosocomial meningitis infections (78/91, 86%) were related to placement of an external ventricular drain (EVD).
claims.byte_quote: Most (78/91, 86%) of the infections were related to the placement of an external ventricular drain (EVD)

claims.text: The incidence of EVD-related infections ranges from 2% to 27%.
claims.byte_quote: the incidence of EVD-related infections ranges from 2% to 27%

claims.text: 26% of Acinetobacter isolates were resistant to imipenem and 27% of patients infected with them died.
claims.byte_quote: 26% of _Acinetobacter_ species were resistant to imipenem and 27% of the patients infected with them died

claims.text: Invasive neurosurgical procedures are exposures predisposing to nosocomial meningitis: craniotomies, internal/external ventricular catheters, lumbar puncture, intrathecal medication infusions, and spinal anesthesia.
claims.byte_quote: invasive procedures (for examples, such as craniotomies, the placement of internal or external ventricular catheters, lumbar puncture, intrathecal infusions of medications, or spinal anesthesia)

claims.text: Risk factors for EVD-related infection include duration of catheterization, frequency of EVD manipulation, intraventricular hemorrhage, and insertion technique.
claims.byte_quote: Relevant risk factors have been identified as the duration of catheterization, frequency of EVD manipulation, intraventricular hemorrhage, and insertion techniques

claims.text: The epidemiology and outcomes described are drawn from Kim et al., a study of nosocomial meningitis.
claims.byte_quote: In this issue of the Korean J Intern Med, Kim et al. [3] described the epidemiology of nosocomial meningitis and its outcomes.

cites: Kim HI, Kim SW, Park GY, et al. The causes and treatment outcomes of 91 patients with adult nosocomial meningitis. Korean J Intern Med. 2012;27:171-179.
